notes:
すぐに has two core meanings: immediately (time) and right there (proximity/distance).

TIME (immediately):
- すぐに⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please come right away
- すぐに⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: I understood immediately

PROXIMITY (nearby):
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧: right there, very close
- ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦そば→そば：00989_soba⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧: the station is right nearby

VARIANT:
⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧ can be used without に with the same meaning. すぐに is slightly more emphatic.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧: immediately (formal, often used in announcements and official contexts)
- ⟦{今|いま}すぐ→今すぐ：25670_imasugu⟧: right now (more urgent than すぐに)
- ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧: soon, shortly (indicates something is about to happen, NOT immediate)
- ⟦さっそく→早速：04173_sassoku⟧: promptly, without delay (implies willingness or eagerness)

WATCH OUT:
⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧ means "soon" (in the near future), while すぐに means "immediately" (without delay). These are not interchangeable.
